derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος);
def: to contract by cutting, i.e. (figuratively) do concisely (speedily)

occurrences.text: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
